ideas.question: What proportion of SUID cases involved infants who slept with an adult compared to the general population of live-born infants?
ideas.why_open: This question explores whether sharing a sleeping surface with an adult is more common among SUID cases than in the general population, potentially indicating a risk factor for SUID.
ideas.data: Case series: ncfrp_v51:D102 Infant Sleep Environment, specifically whether the infant shared a sleeping surface with an adult. Population reference: prams_p8_arf:D281 Sleeping Arrangements, also focusing on sharing a sleeping surface with an adult.

ideas.data: Case series: ncfrp_v51:D88 Pregnancy Weight Gain. Population reference: prams_p8_std2:D299 Pregnancy Weight Gain.
